result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation in the food delivery app interface.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card for 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right edge, showing truncated text and a partially visible card image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling cards have consistent padding and the third card either fully displays or clearly indicates more content via peek/scroll affordance.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon styling is inconsistent between cards; the Ramen card has a white heart on light background while the pizza card has a dark circular background heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and contrast treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card ('−20%' promo) is partially cut off by the bottom navigation area, showing only a portion of the restaurant listing.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding so partially scrolled cards are not awkwardly clipped by the fixed navigation bar.
